description: Add compact, accessible section navigation to the long Info / Cargo overlay so mobile players can jump directly to their objective, cargo/stats, prospecting, hazards, or controls without manually scrolling through the full guide.
steps: Use and consult miner-daily-task-runner before implementing; run ./init.sh, then perform a live desktop and phone-size browser/CDP smoke that starts the game and opens Info / Cargo to reproduce the current long mobile overlay.

Inspect src/ui.tsx, src/dom.ts, src/game.ts, src/styles.css, and the existing ui/startup tests; preserve all runtime IDs/classes and keep current objective, cargo, stats, prospecting, hazard, and control content intact.

Add stable semantic section IDs plus a compact in-overlay navigation control that can move focus/scroll to Objective/Cargo, Stats, Prospecting, Hazards, and Controls; make it keyboard-operable with clear accessible labels and a visible current/target affordance where practical.

Style the navigator and destinations for narrow phone screens as well as desktop, ensuring the close action remains reachable, no HUD controls leak through the modal, long guide rows remain readable, and reduced-motion/normal scrolling behavior is not disruptive.
Add DOM-free or happy-dom test coverage for section navigation targets and React shell hooks, including preservation of the runtime DOM hooks required before initGame().

Run ./init.sh and verify with a live CDP smoke at a phone viewport that starts play, opens Info / Cargo, uses each navigation control, observes the intended section in view, closes the overlay, moves again, and reports no runtime exceptions.
acceptance: On a narrow phone viewport, Info / Cargo exposes clearly labelled, keyboard-accessible navigation to Objective/Cargo, Expedition Stats, Prospecting Guide, Hazard / Fiend Survival, and Controls instead of requiring players to discover those sections by scrolling a multi-screen dialog.

Each navigation action lands on the corresponding visible section, keeps the overlay usable and closable, and does not regress desktop layout, existing guide content, cargo details, objective/service HUD copy, sound controls, or keyboard movement after closing the dialog.
React/runtime hook coverage and navigation-target tests pass, and a phone-size live browser smoke reports no runtime exceptions.
Before marking complete, follow miner-daily-task-runner and run ./test.sh plus canonical verification npm test, npm run typecheck, and npm run build.
